title: feat(state): replay determinism as a check, and a human correction outranks later agent writes
context:
`hunch serve replay --partition <kind:id>` / `--root <dir>` folds a partition's change ledger
into the state it implies and compares it hash for hash (canonical bytes) to the records on
file: replay_hash vs stored_hash, typed divergences (missing-record, hash-drift, orphan-record,
idempotency-drift, legacy-drift), exit 1 on any failure. Compaction keeps the property through
the idempotency table. The agent farm replays every served partition on every run.

New contract invariant human-correction Touches invariant(s): con_902759b3dc (All JSON writes to .hunch/ must be atomic (temp-file + rename) so an interrupted write can never truncate the index); con_a87360128b (Semantic vectors are a derived layer in SQLite, never the source of truth; reconcile by content hash on reindex).
decision: Introduced src/cli, src/core, src/store, test/agent-farm.test.ts, test/state-contract.test.ts, test/state-replay.test.ts: added isHumanConfirmed, ReplayDivergenceKind, ReplayDivergence, ReplaySnapshotEntry, ReplayReport, foldLedger, verifyReplay, formatReplayReport; removed homeFor; new dep(s): node:test, node:assert/strict, node:child_process, node:fs, node:os, node:path; 2 new file(s).
consequences: Adds dependency: node:test, node:assert/strict, node:child_process, node:fs, node:os, node:path.
Removes homeFor — potential breaking change for callers.
